estimates.rule: every A9 figure is an estimate and labelled one; sizes and arenas are exact (train/export.py). Reported for every candidate shape at 333 and 444 MHz with MACs per frame: (a) ocr-speed-resume's method, vita/a9_layers.py measure at #85's head 8d21908 on ocr-speed's 24 development lines of 60-100 frames (pack dev_res.bin), --topk 8 (the LM path), on ocr-speed-resume's two runtime copies (main's code and #85's code at 521f35e, sha256 recorded), with and without --no-pld, every phase's high bound scaled by 1.0006759 (VOCR3-H15's console rate, 4,941.7 us/frame at an assumed 333 MHz, over the high bound of the console's code); a 3-line box = 240 frames + 0.1 s for the finder; (b) VOCR4's vita/budget_sweep.py check (vita/a9_cycles.py, main's tool) on the selected blobs, calibrated the same way
estimates.selectability: a blob is selectable for its tier iff its exact weights and W8I arena meet the tier's limits and its shape's box estimate (a, #85 no-PLD at 333 MHz for Normal's 1 s target; main's runtime at 444 MHz and #85 no-PLD at 333 MHz must both stay under the tier's box_s_le) does; the kernels have no data-dependent branches, so a shape's estimate holds for every blob of that shape

real_pools.dedupe: by line and crop style (amendment 1 of VOCR4, extended): a row of dn, nat, own or rp3 is dropped when an earlier group (tt+tvt, rd+rvt, then dn, nat, own, rp3 in that order) holds a row of the same screenshot (screen_id, else the VNDB image id of the line id) with the same normalised label (eval/metrics.norm) AND the same crop style (ink: hand-cut or margin crops; grad: the console finder's GRAD crop; ref: a refined copy). tt+tvt and rd+rvt are not deduplicated against each other, as in VOCR3 and VOCR4 (two labellers of the same screenshots)
real_pools.build: eval/vocr5_pools.py (a copy of eval/vocr4_pools.py under the rules above) into $HERD/shared/artifacts/vocr5-train/pools/ (the owner pool's copies under $HERD/shared/private/vocr5-train/pools/); eval/vocr5_pools.py check must print CHECK_OK and eval/tools/reserve_check.py --dump $HERD/shared/artifacts/native-frames/vndb/dump/db --pixels RESERVE_OK for every pool before it is pinned

data.finder_augmentation: fa=P (train2 source option, arm F only; train/finder_aug.py by the helper vocr5-aug, prompts/vocr5-aug.md part A, the spec frozen here): with probability P an item's crop gets the finder's extra rows before train2's usual augmentation: 10-60% of the line height added above and below, each side's rows holding with p 0.35 a 1-3 px frame line across 60-100% of the width, p 0.35 a neighbour line's half-cut glyphs (another item of the batch), p 0.15 a furigana fragment (top only), p 0.20 scenery (gradient + noise); with p 0.5 line-end clutter: a trailing next-page cursor 0.5-2 line heights after the text (p 0.6: blob, triangle or star, 0.3-0.7 line heights) or a portrait / ornament edge 0.5-3 line heights wide at either end; the crop is resized back to height 32 keeping its aspect ratio; the label never changes; fa=0 is bit-identical to today's train2

arms.P: the plain fine-tune on every pool: no finder augmentation, no refined copies
arms.F: the finder-robust fine-tune: P's sources and weights, with fa=0.3 on the real ink sources (tt+tvt, rd+rvt, rp3 ink, own ink+m4+m8, dn+nat ink) and fa=0.15 on nv and s2 (not on s3 / s3v3 / s4v5631, whose crops are 75% GRAD already, nor on the GRAD sources), and each GRAD source sampling its refined copies together with the GRAD crops (same source weight)

runs.pairing: v5p_<T>_seedS and v5f_<T>_seedS fine-tune the same pretrain pre5_<T>_seedS with the same fine-tune seed S, so a seed pair differs only by the arm

recipe.pretrain: from scratch, batch 96, lr 2e-3, warmup 1,000, cosine to 0.05, wd 0.01, EMA 0.999, the tier's steps, seed S, 5 threads, eval every 4,000 (logged only: rv/rvn on teacher_val_dev, nvv, s2v), --keep-evals; the final EMA checkpoint (ckpt_step<steps>.pt) is the pretrain. Sources: C (Small) nv 0.5 + s2 0.25 + s3 0.25 (VOCR3/VOCR4-FL10's C_mix pretrain, longer); M (Normal, Large) nv 0.45 + s2 0.225 + s3v3 0.225 + s4v5631 0.1 (VOCR4's M pretrain with one tenth for the new vocab's render); synthetic sources stream=1, pool=3, inv=0.2
recipe.fine_tune: 15,000 steps, batch 96, lr 1.2e-3, warmup 500, cosine to 0.05, wd 0.01, EMA 0.999, kd 0 (hard labels), from the tier's pretrain of the same seed, fine-tune seed S, 5 threads, eval every 2,500 (logged only), --keep-evals; the final EMA checkpoint (ckpt_step15000.pt) is the run. Synthetic half 0.5: C nv 0.25 + s2 0.125 + s3 0.125; M nv 0.225 + s2 0.1125 + s3v3 0.1125 + s4v5631 0.05 (stream=1, pool=3, inv=0.2). Real half 0.5 (inv=0.5, kd=0): tt+tvt 0.15, rd+rvt 0.075, rp3 0.175, own 0.075, dn+nat 0.025; rp3, own and dn+nat are split into an ink source and a GRAD source with weights proportional to their pinned row counts (the split eval/vocr5_pools.sha256 records), the same in both arms
recipe.script: eval/vocr5_run.sh TIER ARM SEED (a copy of eval/vocr4_run.sh) through HEAVY_SLOTS=10 $HERD/heavy.sh (5 threads); outputs $HERD/shared/artifacts/vocr5-train/runs/<run>/; from detached runner worktrees tagged vocr5-runner-<sha>
recipe.order: the slowest first: the Small pretrains at freezing (no render needed), the Normal and Large pretrains when the render is pinned; at most 8 VOCR5 training runs at once (fewer if another training agent asks for slots); fine-tunes when their pretrain and the pool pin exist, Large first
recipe.failures: a pretrain that dies after its first checkpoint resumes from ckpt_last.pt (train2's resume; it reseeds the batch stream: recorded); any other run that dies is deleted and restarted from scratch with the same arguments; every restart or resume is reported

cohorts.rule: the fixed development sample only (eval/manifests/reserved.json dev_sample, 116 VNs: 100 drawn + 16 release partners), the re-carved files of #84 / owner-drive-ingest-2

wd.what: whole dialogue: finder-tighten's tv_dlg and dn_dlg cohorts (#83, $HERD/shared/artifacts/finder-tighten/cohorts, sha256 831f5de9... and 3a279ea8...) restricted to dev_sample VNs: the dialogue region a player draws (labelled non-name lines, eval's grouping, +12/+6 px), at base, +4 and +8 px
wd.pooling: tv_dlg plus the dn_dlg frames teacher_val's regions do not hold (finder-tighten's pooled_dialogue: devnative's tv_native frames are teacher_val's own)

cohorts.report_only: real_val_dev.npz (88a2d4a0..., 807 lines: realdata's labels of teacher_val's screenshots, so not a separate cohort) and every names stratum
cohorts.planetarian: v34 is an owner game and in no dev_sample cohort by construction; eval/vocr5_planetarian_check JSON (vocr4_pools.py vncheck) re-counts it before the first score

score.tool: C runtime W8I only. tv and dn: eval/synth3_ablation.py score (pyvocr, views rv = console polarity as stored and rvn = screen polarity), per line; wd: eval/finder_tighten.py score --cohorts $HERD/shared/artifacts/vocr5-train/cohorts (the C GRAD finder, flags 0, and the C refinement, VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT, each line read with the finder's dark flag as VOCR_INVERT, joined and scored with the textbox guard's transcript_score)
score.dialogue: a line is a name, and leaves the primary score, when devnative tags it 'name' (dn) or when it is name-like in teacher_val (eval/synth3_ablation.strata 'namelike': at most 6 characters after metrics.norm and no dialogue punctuation); wd regions hold no name by construction
score.components: tv = teacher_val's dialogue errors over its dialogue reference characters, both views summed; dn = the same over devnative's four files pooled, both views; wd = the pooled whole-dialogue errors over reference characters, both finder modes and the three region variants summed
score.dev_score: 0.5 x (tv + dn) / 2 + 0.5 x wd, in CER points: the fixed-line half is VOCR4's development score restricted to dialogue, the other half the overlay's own reading path
score.names: the same tv and dn rates on name lines: a secondary column, deciding nothing

decisions.bootstrap: paired, stratified VN-cluster: 10,000 resamples (numpy default_rng seed 0); tv's, dn's and wd's VNs resampled independently (each component its own strata), the dev score recomputed per resample; the interval is the 2.5-97.5 percentiles of the mean over the seed pairs of the dev-score difference
decisions.arm: per tier, P -> F over the seed pairs (v5p_<T>_seedS, v5f_<T>_seedS): F is adopted iff the interval of the dev-score difference lies entirely below 0, every seed pair's difference is below 0, and none of the three components' own intervals lies entirely above 0; otherwise P
decisions.replace: per tier, X -> the incumbent, X the adopted arm: the incumbent's blob is scored once on the same cohorts; X replaces it iff the interval of mean over seeds of (X_seedS - incumbent) lies entirely below 0, every seed's difference is below 0, and no component's interval lies entirely above 0. If X does not, the other arm is not tried and the incumbent stays the tier's model
decisions.order: a tier's arm decision once its 2 x seeds fine-tunes are scored, then its replace decision; each decision file is committed before that tier's selection

selection.rule: per tier, if X replaces the incumbent: the run of X with the lowest dev score (ties at 5 decimals to the lower seed), among the blobs that are selectable (estimates.selectability); otherwise the incumbent
selection.reported: every run of the tier is scored and listed with every component, the names column and the budget check
selection.commit: each tier's selection (scores, decisions, the selected run, its blob sha256) is committed and pushed before the locked report runs

locked_report.when: once, after the three selections are committed
locked_report.tool: eval/vocr3_report.py (shared, a9, overlay, render) with the spec of eval/vocr5_make_spec.py (a copy of eval/vocr4_make_spec.py); the commit is recorded

sets.fixed lines: vita-test and psp-test through the scalar C W8I runtime, console polarity primary, native also; per set, per style, per VN, pooled; dialogue (lines without the 'name' style) primary, all text and names also; hiragana
sets.whole dialogue: each region at base, +4 and +8 px with the arm's C finder (VOCR2's held-out guard scoring); body (dialogue) text primary
sets.deployed decode (report only): the VOCR4 and VOCR5 models' fixed lines with vocr_cli --lm and the overlay's default 1 MB LM (vocr_lm_o3_1000k.vlm, v0.2.6-ctclm.2) at docs/ctc-lm-decode.json's settings for that tier, through eval/run.py's cmd: backend

locked_report.statistics: CAND - BASE in points, paired bootstrap 95% intervals (10,000 resamples, seed 0) over lines and VN clusters (strata with at least 5 VNs)
locked_report.gates: VOCR2's fixed-line gate and whole-dialogue guard for VOCR5_S vs VOCR1, VOCR5_N vs VOCR_H15 and VOCR5_L vs VOCR_H15, reported. The owner's 13:26Z instruction makes VOCR5 the overlay's default whatever they say; the report states each gate's result
